title: Long-term exposure to a hypomagnetic field attenuates adult hippocampal neurogenesis and cognition
description: Male mice exposed to 0.29 ± 0.01 µT versus local 55.26 ± 0.05 µT; neurogenesis, cognition, ROS measurements.

title: Core field changes from eleven years of Swarm satellite observations
description: Swarm-derived surface-field SAA minimum: 22,430 nT (2014.0) and 22,094 nT (2025.0), a 336 nT decline.

title: World Magnetic Model 2025
description: WMM2025 standard main-field model; local total intensity F depends on coordinates, altitude and date; not a real-time sensor.

title: GSK-3β and mTOR Phosphorylation Mediate the Reversible Regulation of Hypomagnetic Field on Adult Neural Stem Cell Proliferation
description: Investigates reversible adult neural stem cell effects and phosphorylation pathways in hypomagnetic exposure.

title: Mitochondria as key targets underlying hypomagnetic field-induced biological effects
description: Review proposes mitochondrial quality-control pathways and potential roles for iron-sulfur clusters; not proof of a single mechanism.

title: The Effects of Extremely Low Geomagnetic Field Intensity on the Mammalian Central Nervous System
description: Conference summary of hypomagnetic effects; distinct evidence level from a fully reported peer-reviewed experiment.

title: Hypomagnetic fields modulate lifespan, physical ability and mitochondrial metabolism in a Pink1 model of neurodegeneration
description: A neurodegeneration model reports context-dependent biological responses, underscoring that effects should not be simplified to a universal direction.

title: NOAA planetary K-index observations
kind: continuously updated official NOAA observational index
description: Observed planetary 3-hour Kp index; unitless and not a direct measurement of Earth surface total field F. Current machine feed: https://services.swpc.noaa.gov/products/noaa-planetary-k-index.json. Product format changed to arrays of JSON objects in March 2026.

title: NOAA near-real-time solar wind magnetic field summary
description: Bt and GSM Bz in nanotesla, measured upstream in solar wind and not equal to the surface geomagnetic main field. Feed includes timestamps.
